$comment: GENERATED by platforms/steam/scripts/gen-achievements.ts from src/game/balance.ts + content.ts. Edit the script, not this file.

rules.steamLimit: Steam allows 100 achievements until the app reaches the Profile Features threshold; we use 84.
rules.icons: 256x256 JPG per achievement: achieved (colour) + unachieved (greyscale). Steam still accepts the legacy 64x64.
rules.hidden: Hidden achievements (story endings, secrets) do not appear on the Community page until earned: no spoilers.
rules.secrets: Secret names marked placeholder are provisional: the secrets owner should replace them with the reveal titles.
rules.progress: Achievements with a progress stat show a bar in Steam and auto-unlock when the stat reaches max.
rules.languages: Fill English + Spanish (Spain) + Spanish (Latin America) with the es text.
